watchdog_manifest_repair: The independent watchdog namespaces compatibility refs per run/attempt (refs/pantheon-proof/${GITHUB_RUN_ID}-${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT}/*), eliminating shared static ref collisions across concurrent runs.
The watchdog asserts both namespaced refs resolve to the authorized CANDIDATE_SHA and BFF_SHA immediately before generating the runtime compatibility manifest.
The watchdog dynamically generates the release compatibility manifest with exact runtime commits before invoking the Agora deployment gate.

The watchdog restore step is marked `if: always()` and the compatibility revalidation step is marked `continue-on-error: true` so any pre-restore failure or race condition unconditionally falls through to the exact same-pair read-only restore path.
credential_controller: Repository actions secret DEV_BFF_DEV_LOGIN_VIEWER_CLIENT_SECRET provisioned on execute-plans repository to supply required dedicated viewer client credentials alongside DEV_BFF_DEV_LOGIN_OPERATOR_A_CLIENT_SECRET.
Both operator and viewer tokens are freshly minted at runtime via /bff/auth/dev-login with strict TTL (>1200s) and max-age (<120s) preflight.
not_changed: Product runtime contracts, BFF API contracts, and default read-only deployment profile.
No live capital action and no outbound Source Ingestion external pulls.
Watchdog single-coordinator architecture and fail-closed restore semantics.
